objective: Create a new image with the painterly aesthetic of the references
scene: A terracotta Mediterranean villa beside the sea, with two palm trees in the foreground, a small boat in the bay and golden late-afternoon light.

format.composition: One scene filling the entire image

style.visual_technique: Oil on canvas with thick impasto
style.paint_application: Palette knife and short, dense, irregular brushstrokes
style.texture: Pronounced relief, paint ridges and clearly visible overlapping strokes
style.representation: Figurative, with recognizable subjects and details simplified into patches of paint
style.finish: Handcrafted, tactile and slightly glossy along the impasto ridges
style.edge_treatment: Alternating defined contours and edges broken by brushwork

mood.character: Traditional painting with editorial photography framing
related_themes: Coastal landscapes with villas and palm trees

color.approach: A limited palette consistent with the scene
color.saturation: Deep, saturated colors in color versions
color.shadows: Dark, with intense blacks and chromatic nuances

lighting.treatment: Deep shadows and highlights that model the subjects
lighting.texture: Small highlights and shadows that reveal the relief of the paint

composition.depth: Distinct foreground, middle ground and background
composition.visual_focus: Main subject clearly readable among the brushstrokes
composition.detail: Greater definition at the focal point and painterly simplification in secondary areas

base_prompt: Depict the specified scene as a figurative oil painting with thick impasto and palette knife work. Use dense, irregular, overlapping brushstrokes, with visible paint ridges across the entire surface. Keep the subjects recognizable and concentrate detail at the main focal point. Use a coherent palette, deep shadows and intense highlights. Aim for an elegant, cinematic atmosphere with editorial framing. The image should feel hand-painted, with physical paint relief, without looking like a photograph with a texture filter. Landscape 16:9 format, one scene, no text or interface elements.
